versions.changelog:
Major upgrade with expanded features and advanced Git guidance:

- Added comprehensive documentation on advanced Git workflows (Gitflow, trunk-based, GitHub Flow).
- Introduced detailed sections on Git hooks with example scripts for automation and commit quality.
- Integrated CI/CD guidance for GitHub Actions and GitLab pipelines.
- Expanded monorepo support, including worktrees, sparse checkout, and submodules.
- Added a deep dive into Git internals (objects, refs, packfiles) and advanced commands.
- Included best practices and quick command reference for efficient Git usage.
